name: OpenVibe.Download
description: OpenVibe.Download will be the file home of the OpenVibe network: large uploads and simple share links with or without an account, folders, sync and backups when you sign in, and AI that previews, sorts and finds your files, in the spirit of MediaFire and MEGA, built on OpenVibe.Media and open through the API.

pillars.title: Share links
pillars.text: Big files, simple links, clear limits.

pillars.title: Drive & backup
pillars.text: Folders, sync and backups under your OpenVibe account.

pillars.title: Smart files
pillars.text: Previews, search and summaries from the network's AI.

pillars.title: Built for apps
pillars.text: The same file service every OpenVibe site and your own apps use.
